hook: Some dresses make you go quiet.

excerpt.text: It took six minutes to do up the buttons with the hook.

excerpt: By the end of it Tamsin had stopped talking. They usually did.

excerpt.text: Something about being fastened into a thing from behind, by somebody else, made people quiet.
‘It’s a costume.’ But she didn’t look away from it.

caption:
Three Lyall brides have worn this dress. Nine days before the next wedding, it comes to Nell’s workroom in Bath.
